These routes of the platform API come from its [OpenAPI document](../openapi.json); [The REST API as a contract](../rest-api.md) says what Lakana promises about them.

## `GET /api/v1/principals/{name}/interface-state`

Show what the web interface remembers for you

Only your own (403 for another person's name, and for a task or CI token). A person who never changed anything gets the defaults: the tour not seen, Get started shown, no update note seen.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | Your principal name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `InterfaceStateOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `InterfaceStateOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tour_seen` | true or false | yes |  |
| `get_started_hidden` | true or false | yes |  |
| `update_note_seen` | text or null | yes |  |

## `PATCH /api/v1/principals/{name}/interface-state`

Change what the web interface remembers for you

Changes only the fields sent. `update_note_seen` takes a release version, `x.y.z`; anything else, a development build's version too, is refused with 422 and nothing in the request is stored. So the interface records the tour in a request of its own, which no version can hold up. Only your own (403 otherwise, and for a task or CI token).

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | Your principal name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `InterfaceStateIn`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tour_seen` | true or false or null | no |  |
| `get_started_hidden` | true or false or null | no |  |
| `update_note_seen` | text or null | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `InterfaceStateOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `InterfaceStateOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tour_seen` | true or false | yes |  |
| `get_started_hidden` | true or false | yes |  |
| `update_note_seen` | text or null | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/principals/{name}/recent`

List what you opened recently, newest first

At most 20. Something you may no longer read, or that no longer exists, is left out. Only your own (403 otherwise, and for a task or CI token).

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | Your principal name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | list of `RecentOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `POST /api/v1/principals/{name}/recent`

Record that you opened a table, a query, a job or a run

The web interface's detail pages call it. Opening the same object again within a minute changes nothing; only the newest 20 are kept. Answers 404 when the object does not exist or you may not read it (the same answer for both). Only your own (403 otherwise, and for a task or CI token).

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | yes | text | Your principal name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `RecentIn`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | one of `table`, `query`, `job`, `run` | yes |  |
| `environment` | text | yes |  |
| `ref` | text | yes |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Successful Response | none |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |
